preconditions.description: The number of rows must be greater than 0.
The number of columns must be greater than 0.

postconditions.description: The returned array has the correct number of rows.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == columns for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each row in the returned array has the correct number of columns.

postconditions.expression: all(all(cell in ['O', 'X'] for cell in row) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each cell in the returned array contains either 'O' or 'X'.

postconditions.expression: all(all(row[i] != row[i+1] for i in range(columns-1)) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: The chessboard pattern alternates between 'O' and 'X' for each row.
